name: Wisconsin 4-H Agriculture Ambassadors
org: University of Wisconsin-Madison Division of Extension, Wisconsin 4-H
what_you_do: Teens in grades 9 to 12 speak up for farming. They lead events across the state and give talks to counties. They build leadership skills with meetings and weekends all year.
who_can_apply: Wisconsin youth in grades 9 to 12 at the time of application.
pay_detail: $500 (shirts, lodging and meals at four events). Scholarships up to 70% on request.
duration: One program year (events April to November 2027)
deadline_text: Applications run Oct 1 to Nov 15. The page does not state the year; its key dates are in 2027, so this is likely fall 2026. Selection decisions are Jan 6. Confirm the year first.
how_to_apply: Apply through 4-H Online. The team checks references in December.
notes: Key 2027 dates: State Leader Teams Weekend Apr 9 to 11, Fall Forum Nov 5 to 7.
